<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>Happy 16th Birthday, Toni! 🎂</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --kraft-1: #caa06e;
    --kraft-2: #b58750;
    --ink: #4a2e2e;
    --pink-deep: #c14d78;
    --pink-mid: #e78aa8;
    --pink-pale: #fbe1e8;
    --cream: #fff1e6;
    --shadow: rgba(60, 30, 20, 0.35);
  }

  *{ box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

  html, body{
    margin:0; padding:0; height:100%;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }

  body{
    min-height:100vh;
    background-color: var(--kraft-2);
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 90%, rgba(0,0,0,0.18), transparent 55%),
      repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 2px, transparent 2px, transparent 5px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(25deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.035) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 4px),
      linear-gradient(160deg, var(--kraft-1), var(--kraft-2));
    background-blend-mode: normal, normal, overlay, overlay, normal;
  }

  #stage{
    min-height:100vh;
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    padding: 9vh 4vw 6vh;
  }

  h1.sr-only{
    position:absolute; width:1px;height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0);
  }

  .stack{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    display:grid;
    place-items:start center;
  }
  .stack > *{ grid-area: 1 / 1; }

  /* ---------- COVER ---------- */
  #cover-wrap{
    transition: opacity .55s ease, transform .55s ease;
    opacity:1;
    transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 30px var(--shadow));
  }
  #app.open #cover-wrap{
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(.82) rotate(-2deg);
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  #cover-btn{
    appearance:none; border:none; background:none; padding:0; margin:0; cursor:pointer;
    display:block;
    width: min(78vw, 360px);
  }
  #cover-btn img{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:auto;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 6px solid #fff8f2;
    outline: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }
  .tap-hint{
    margin-top:14px;
    text-align:center;
    font-size: 15px;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    color: #fff3e6;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    animation: bob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bob{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(5px); }
  }

  /* ---------- BOOK / SPREAD ---------- */
  #book{
    transition: opacity .55s ease, transform .55s ease;
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(.9);
    pointer-events:none;
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
  }
  #app.open #book{
    opacity:1;
    transform: scale(1);
    pointer-events:auto;
  }

  #back-btn{
    appearance:none; cursor:pointer;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 9px 18px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight:600;
    color: var(--pink-deep);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  #back-btn:active{ transform: translateY(1px); }

  .spread{
    perspective: 2200px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap: 0;
    width:100%;
    max-width: 880px;
  }

  .page-btn{
    appearance:none; border:none; padding:0; margin:0; cursor:pointer;
    background:none;
    width: min(45vw, 340px);
    aspect-ratio: 1240 / 1748;
    position:relative;
    transform-style: preserve-3d;
    transition: transform .85s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.2,1), opacity .7s ease;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 26px var(--shadow));
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .page-left.page-btn{
    transform-origin: right center;
    transform: rotateY(-92deg);
    opacity: 0;
    border-top-right-radius:0; border-bottom-right-radius:0;
  }
  .page-right{
    transform-origin: left center;
    transform: rotateY(92deg);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform .85s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.2,1) .05s, opacity .7s ease .05s;
    width: min(45vw, 340px);
    aspect-ratio: 1240 / 1748;
    position:relative;
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow:hidden;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 26px var(--shadow));
  }
  #app.open .page-left.page-btn{ transform: rotateY(0deg); opacity:1; }
  #app.open .page-right{ transform: rotateY(0deg); opacity:1; }

  .spine{
    width: 14px;
    align-self:stretch;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.22), rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0.22));
    flex-shrink:0;
  }

  /* ---------- LEFT PAGE: envelope + letter ---------- */
  .page-left{ background: var(--pink-pale); }
  .env-layer, .letter-layer{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .env-layer{
    z-index:3;
  }
  .env-layer img{
    width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;
  }
  .letter-layer{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding: 9%;
    z-index:1;
    transform: translateY(60%) scale(.86);
    opacity:0;
    transition: transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1), opacity .4s ease, z-index 0s .55s;
  }
  .letter-layer img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:contain;
    border-radius:3px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    background:#fff;
    transition: box-shadow .4s ease;
  }
  .page-left.lifted .letter-layer{
    z-index:5;
    opacity:1;
    transform: translateY(0%) scale(1.02);
    transition: transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1), opacity .3s ease;
  }
  .page-left.lifted .letter-layer img{
    box-shadow: 0 26px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .page-left.lifted .env-layer{
    filter: brightness(.88) saturate(.9);
  }
  .peek-hint{
    position:absolute;
    bottom: 6%;
    left:0; right:0;
    text-align:center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--pink-deep);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    padding: 5px 0;
    z-index:3;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    pointer-events:none;
    transition: opacity .3s ease;
  }
  .page-left.lifted .peek-hint{ opacity:0; }

  /* ---------- RIGHT PAGE: cake + candles ---------- */
  .page-right{ background: var(--pink-pale); }
  .cake-wrap{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
  }
  .cake-wrap > img{
    width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;
  }
  .flame{
    position:absolute;
    transform-origin: 50% 92%;
    will-change: transform;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .flame img{
    width:100%; height:auto; display:block;
  }
  .flame.out{
    transition: opacity .5s ease, transform .5s ease;
    opacity:0;
    transform: translateY(6%) scale(.35) rotate(0deg) !important;
  }

  .cake-controls{
    position:absolute;
    left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
    padding: 3.5% 6% 5%;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,255,255,0.92), rgba(255,255,255,0.0));
    z-index:5;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
  }
  .meter{
    width:100%;
    max-width:220px;
    height:9px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    border-radius:999px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .meter-fill{
    height:100%; width:0%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pink-mid), var(--pink-deep));
    transition: width .06s linear;
  }
  .meter-label{
    font-size:11px;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity:.75;
  }
  .hold-btn{
    appearance:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    background: var(--pink-deep);
    color:#fff;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:13px;
    padding: 9px 20px;
    border-radius:999px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(193,77,120,0.4);
    margin-top:2px;
    user-select:none;
    -webkit-user-select:none;
  }
  .hold-btn:active, .hold-btn.holding{
    transform: translateY(1px) scale(.97);
    background: var(--pink-mid);
  }
  .hold-btn.emphasize{
    animation: pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse{
    0%,100%{ box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(193,77,120,0.4); }
    50%{ box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(193,77,120,0.85); }
  }
  .mic-note{
    font-size:10.5px;
    text-align:center;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity:.65;
    max-width:240px;
    line-height:1.4;
  }

  /* ---------- WISH OVERLAY ---------- */
  .wish-overlay{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    z-index:20;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:16px;
    background: rgba(255,241,230,0.0);
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    transition: opacity .5s ease;
  }
  .wish-overlay.show{
    opacity:1;
    pointer-events:auto;
    background: rgba(255,241,230,0.55);
  }
  #confetti{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .wish-text{
    position:relative;
    z-index:2;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 5vw, 24px);
    font-weight:700;
    color: var(--pink-deep);
    background: #fff;
    padding: 14px 22px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    text-align:center;
    transform: rotate(-2deg);
  }
  #relightBtn{
    position:relative; z-index:2;
    appearance:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    background:#fff;
    color: var(--pink-deep);
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:14px;
    padding: 10px 22px;
    border-radius:999px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  }
  #relightBtn:active{ transform: translateY(1px); }

  @media (max-width: 480px){
    .spread{ gap:0; }
    .spine{ width:9px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1 class="sr-only">Happy 16th Birthday Toni — interactive card</h1>

<div id="stage">
  <div id="app" class="stack">

    <div id="cover-wrap">
      <button id="cover-btn" aria-label="Open birthday card">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Happy 16th Birthday Toni" />
      </button>
      <div class="tap-hint">tap the card to open ✨</div>
    </div>

    <div id="book">
      <button id="back-btn" type="button">← back to cover</button>
      <div class="spread">

        <button class="page-left page-btn" id="pageLeft" type="button" aria-label="Open letter">
          <div class="env-layer"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Envelope with letter tucked inside" /></div>
          <div class="letter-layer"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Birthday letter to Toni" /></div>
          <div class="peek-hint">tap to read the letter</div>
        </button>

        <div class="spine"></div>

        <div class="page-right" id="pageRight">
          <div class="cake-wrap">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Birthday cake with candles" />
            <div class="flame" id="flame-A" data-name="A"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-B" data-name="B"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-C" data-name="C"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-D" data-name="D"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-E" data-name="E"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-F" data-name="F"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
            <div class="flame" id="flame-G" data-name="G"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""/></div>
          </div>

          <div class="wish-overlay" id="wishOverlay">
            <canvas id="confetti"></canvas>
            <div class="wish-text">Make a wish, Toni! 🎂</div>
            <button id="relightBtn" type="button">Relight candles</button>
          </div>

          <div class="cake-controls">
            <div class="meter"><div class="meter-fill" id="meterFill"></div></div>
            <div class="meter-label">🎤 mic level</div>
            <button class="hold-btn" id="holdBtn" type="button">Hold to blow (or press &amp; hold Space)</button>
            <div class="mic-note" id="micNote">Requesting microphone…</div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  var appEl = document.getElementById('app');
  var coverBtn = document.getElementById('cover-btn');
  var backBtn = document.getElementById('back-btn');
  var pageLeft = document.getElementById('pageLeft');
  var holdBtn = document.getElementById('holdBtn');
  var meterFill = document.getElementById('meterFill');
  var micNote = document.getElementById('micNote');
  var wishOverlay = document.getElementById('wishOverlay');
  var relightBtn = document.getElementById('relightBtn');

  // ---------- open / close book ----------
  coverBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    appEl.classList.add('open');
    startMic();
  });
  backBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    appEl.classList.remove('open');
  });

  // ---------- letter tuck / lift ----------
  pageLeft.addEventListener('click', function(){
    pageLeft.classList.toggle('lifted');
  });

  // ================= CANDLE BLOWING =================

  var FLAME_POS = {"A": {"left": 46.855, "top": 41.648, "width": 6.532}, "B": {"left": 26.371, "top": 43.535, "width": 6.452}, "C": {"left": 64.435, "top": 43.535, "width": 6.532}, "D": {"left": 18.065, "top": 52.46, "width": 6.532}, "E": {"left": 76.371, "top": 52.46, "width": 6.532}, "F": {"left": 31.371, "top": 57.78, "width": 6.452}, "G": {"left": 64.435, "top": 57.78, "width": 6.532}};

  var flameEls = {};
  Object.keys(FLAME_POS).forEach(function(k){
    var el = document.getElementById('flame-' + k);
    var p = FLAME_POS[k];
    el.style.left = p.left + '%';
    el.style.top = p.top + '%';
    el.style.width = p.width + '%';
    flameEls[k] = {
      el: el,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 1.6 + Math.random() * 0.9,
      lean: (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.6 + Math.random()*0.4)
    };
  });

  var BLOW_THRESHOLD = 0.10;
  var BLOW_TIME_TO_OUT = 500; // ms
  var blowTime = 0;
  var smoothedVol = 0;
  var extinguished = false;
  var holding = false;
  var lastFrameTime = null;

  var audioCtx = null, analyser = null, dataArray = null, micReady = false;

  function startMic(){
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){
      micUnavailable();
      return;
    }
    if (location.protocol !== 'https:' && location.hostname !== 'localhost'){
      micNote.textContent = 'This page needs to be hosted over https for the mic to work — use the hold-to-blow button below for now.';
      holdBtn.classList.add('emphasize');
      return;
    }
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
      .then(function(stream){
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        var source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
        analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = 1024;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.2;
        source.connect(analyser);
        dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
        micReady = true;
        micNote.textContent = 'Mic connected — blow toward your device 🎈';
      })
      .catch(function(){
        micUnavailable();
      });
  }

  function micUnavailable(){
    micNote.textContent = 'Mic unavailable or blocked — use the hold-to-blow button below (or press & hold Space).';
    holdBtn.classList.add('emphasize');
  }

  function getMicVolume(){
    if (!micReady) return 0;
    analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
    var sum = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++){
      var v = (dataArray[i] - 128) / 128;
      sum += v * v;
    }
    var rms = Math.sqrt(sum / dataArray.length);
    return Math.min(1, rms * 5.5);
  }

  // ---------- hold-to-blow fallback ----------
  function setHolding(v){
    holding = v;
    holdBtn.classList.toggle('holding', v);
  }
  holdBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); setHolding(true); });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', function(){ setHolding(false); });
  holdBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', function(){ /* keep holding until pointerup, per spec */ });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.code === 'Space'){ e.preventDefault(); setHolding(true); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
    if (e.code === 'Space'){ e.preventDefault(); setHolding(false); }
  });

  // ---------- main loop ----------
  function frame(t){
    if (lastFrameTime === null) lastFrameTime = t;
    var dt = t - lastFrameTime;
    lastFrameTime = t;

    var rawVol = holding ? 1 : getMicVolume();
    smoothedVol = smoothedVol * 0.7 + rawVol * 0.3;

    meterFill.style.width = Math.round(smoothedVol * 100) + '%';

    if (!extinguished){
      // bend flames
      var now = t / 1000;
      Object.keys(flameEls).forEach(function(k){
        var f = flameEls[k];
        var flicker = Math.sin(now * f.speed + f.phase) * 4; // gentle idle flicker in degrees
        var blowAngle = smoothedVol * 34 * f.lean;
        var angle = flicker + blowAngle;
        var lift = -Math.min(10, smoothedVol * 10);
        f.el.style.transform = 'translateY(' + lift + '%) rotate(' + angle.toFixed(1) + 'deg)';
      });

      if (smoothedVol > BLOW_THRESHOLD){
        blowTime += dt;
      } else {
        blowTime = Math.max(0, blowTime - dt * 2.2);
      }

      if (blowTime >= BLOW_TIME_TO_OUT){
        extinguishCandles();
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

  function extinguishCandles(){
    extinguished = true;
    var i = 0;
    Object.keys(flameEls).forEach(function(k){
      var f = flameEls[k];
      setTimeout(function(){
        f.el.classList.add('out');
      }, i * 60);
      i++;
    });
    setTimeout(showWish, 550);
  }

  function showWish(){
    wishOverlay.classList.add('show');
    startConfetti();
  }

  relightBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    extinguished = false;
    blowTime = 0;
    smoothedVol = 0;
    wishOverlay.classList.remove('show');
    stopConfetti();
    Object.keys(flameEls).forEach(function(k){
      flameEls[k].el.classList.remove('out');
    });
  });

  // ================= CONFETTI =================
  var canvas = document.getElementById('confetti');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var confettiParticles = [];
  var confettiRunning = false;
  var confettiColors = ['#c14d78', '#e78aa8', '#fbe1e8', '#ffd166', '#ffffff', '#8a5a8f'];

  function resizeCanvas(){
    var rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    canvas.width = rect.width;
    canvas.height = rect.height;
  }

  function startConfetti(){
    resizeCanvas();
    confettiParticles = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++){
      confettiParticles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: -20 - Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.5,
        r: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        c: confettiColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * confettiColors.length)],
        vy: 1.4 + Math.random() * 2.2,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI,
        vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2
      });
    }
    confettiRunning = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(confettiFrame);
  }

  function stopConfetti(){
    confettiRunning = false;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  }

  function confettiFrame(){
    if (!confettiRunning) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var stillFalling = false;
    confettiParticles.forEach(function(p){
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.rot += p.vr;
      if (p.y < canvas.height + 20) stillFalling = true;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
      ctx.fillRect(-p.r, -p.r * 0.6, p.r * 2, p.r * 1.2);
      ctx.restore();
    });
    if (stillFalling){
      requestAnimationFrame(confettiFrame);
    } else {
      // relaunch a light sprinkle to keep the moment alive while overlay is open
      startConfetti();
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    if (confettiRunning) resizeCanvas();
  });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
